entities.summary: Khabib Mevlidinovich Allakhverdiev is a Russian former professional boxer who competed from 2007 to 2015. He held the WBA (Regular) and IBO super-lightweight titles from 2012 to 2014, and as an amateur won a bronze medal in the lightweight division at the 2005 World Championships.
